title: Osiris Shaft water samples tested with the Osirion 7 mission

tellings.quote: we've actually taken samples of the water in the Osiris Shaft and I had that tested in conjunction with an archaeological project that I'm a member of called the Osirion 7 archaeological mission in conjunction with Jim Westerman to investigate the source of the water within the Osirion.

plain: Water taken from the Osiris Shaft, a deep flooded shaft beneath the Giza plateau near the pyramids, is said to have been sampled and lab tested. Jeffrey Drum, a researcher who argues the pyramids once worked as a kind of energy system, tells Michels he took part himself, testing the water with an archaeological group called the Osirion 7 mission, alongside Jim Westerman, to find "the source of the water within the Osirion," an ancient underground temple in Egypt. He uses the results to support his idea that water played a part in how the pyramids worked.
